We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate ~mission(Location|Address) to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

missions.title: Critical Intelligence Lost
missions.description:
One of our most dedicated people, ~mission(TargetName) has gone missing and I'm beside myself thinking what might have happened to them. They had been working undercover to gather intelligence on some local outlaws and managed to track down where some critical data was being stored. 

We need you to go, discern what happened to them, and if the worst has happened, continue their mission to destroy the sensitive data before it can be used against us.

From their last check in with their handler, we believe they were headed to ~mission(Location|Address). I suggest you start your search at the small outposts near there.

Please hurry,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Missing Volunteers
missions.description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of ~mission(Location|Address). It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description:
One of our most trusted datarunners, ~mission(TargetName), has found themselves the victim of a XenoThreat assault. Now both they and the data they were ferrying have been captured and taken to ~mission(Location|Address). 

I am charging you with heading there to ascertain what happened to ~mission(TargetName|First) and to destroy data servers which may be housing the stolen information.

Even if the worst has happened, I think they would want us to make sure they data they were charged with protecting isn't used for nefarious gains.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Find XenoThreat Captive and Stolen Data
missions.description:
The family of ~mission(TargetName), a Citizens for Prosperity courier, has been in contact with me with the terrible news that they never arrived back home. We learned that ~mission(TargetName|First) was captured by XenoThreat while transporting some critical data. 

We need you to search ~mission(Location|Address) and see if you can learn what has become of ~mission(TargetName|First) and then destroy any XenoThreat servers that may contain stolen data.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Find Headhunter Captive and Stolen Data
missions.description:
I just have received confirmation that ~mission(TargetName), a Citizens for Prosperity courier, was captured by the Headhunters while transporting some critical data. 

We need you to investigate ~mission(Location|Address) to discover what happened to ~mission(TargetName|First) and then destroy any Headhunter servers that may contain stolen data.

We're counting on you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Find … and Missing Supplies
missions.description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named ~mission(TargetName) who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at ~mission(Location|Address). I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate ~mission(TargetName|First)? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to ~mission(Destination|Address). I’ll give you the same warning I gave ~mission(TargetName|First), that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Search a XenoThreat Remote Outpost
missions.description:
Hi,

Got a tough assignment here. There’s a small, satellite outpost near ~mission(Location|Address) that needs to be investigated. I received intel that it’s housing some of our stolen supplies and sent ~mission(TargetName) to retrieve them. Haven’t heard anything from them in a while and am worried they ran into trouble.

XenoThreat controls that location, but I hoped ~mission(TargetName|First) could slip in and out without getting noticed. Seems like that spot might be more heavily guarded than expected. Looking for someone to take a look and see what happened to ~mission(TargetName|First). Also, if any of our supplies are found there, I need them taken to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Do you think you can give it a shot? I’m guessing that the Xenos are entrenched there. Prepare accordingly and don’t expect them to make this easy on you.  

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Investigate Headhunters Outpost
missions.description:
Hey,

I’ve been tracking Headhunters activity at ~mission(Location|Address). Recently, they stocked it with supplies we believe were stolen from one of our cargo convoys. ~mission(TargetName) offered to go get our goods back but hasn’t checked in since. Really need to know what happened to them and if our supplies are there.

Think this is something you could handle? You’ll probably have to deal with Headhunters forces to get to the bottom of this. Also, any goods you grab should go to ~mission(Destination|Address) once you’re out of there.

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Investigate Missing Pilot and Cargo
missions.description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, ~mission(TargetName), was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) to ascertain what has happened to ~mission(TargetName|First), destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to ~mission(Destination|Address).

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at ~mission(Location|Address). We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down ~mission(TargetName|First) on our behalf.

missions.description:

Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

missions.title: Intercepted Supply Run
missions.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at ~mission(Location|Address) and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address). Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

missions.title: Recovering Valuable Supplies
missions.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at ~mission(Location|Address) and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address) and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at ~mission(Destination|Address) when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at ~mission(Location|Address). There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination)  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at ~mission(Location|Address) is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address) and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Special Recovery Operation
missions.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  ~mission(Location|Address) in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at ~mission(Destination|Address).

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Retrieve Supplies
missions.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a ~mission(Ship) carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at ~mission(Location|Address). We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at ~mission(Destination|Address). Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a ~mission(Ship) moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around ~mission(Location|Address), which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to ~mission(Destination). 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to ~mission(Destination|Address). Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott

missions.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at ~mission(Destination). 

Looks like the goods ended up at ~mission(Location|Address). Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to ~mission(Destination|Address). Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott

missions.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party
missions.description:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of ~mission(Location|Address). 

To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain. 

Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Clear CFP Route of Hostiles
missions.description:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to ~mission(Location|Address) and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
missions.description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out ~mission(Location|Address) only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
missions.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to ~mission(Location|Address) and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
missions.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a ~mission(AmbushTarget). Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that ~mission(Location|Address) is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

Good luck,

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a ~mission(AmbushTarget), was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

Good luck,

missions.title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
missions.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at ~mission(Location) and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
missions.description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Orison Platforms Under Attack
missions.description:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: In the Wake of Disaster
missions.description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near ~mission(Location) that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

missions.title: Pacheco Stanton1 Hijacked Ship Caterpillar
missions.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are ~mission(NameSave2), ~mission(NameKill1), ~mission(NameSave3), and ~mission(NameSave1). All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

missions.title: limited supply
missions.description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

missions.title: out of stock
missions.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

missions.title: inventory clear out
missions.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

missions.title: makin’ a mess
missions.description:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill everyone who’s there. 

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

missions.title: too many cooks
missions.description:
A client is getting out produced by a new competitor and is looking to throw a wrench into the works.

You’re going to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill all the civies who work there. 

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

missions.title: live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge
missions.description: Everybody holds grudges, right? I mean, when you get popped pulling a crime, I get that you’re a little sour, but that’s pretty much the game, right?

missions.title: good help’s hard to find
missions.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at ~mission(Location|Address), but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

missions.title: let's help each other
missions.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

missions.description:

We’ve had our sights set on taking out ~mission(TargetName) for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the ~mission(Location). Kill enough of those losers, and ~mission(TargetName|Last) will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

missions.description:

We need you to find a ~mission(ship) that got punched out around ~mission(location). Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

missions.title: Orison Relief: Strike Nine Tails Squad
missions.description:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near ~mission(Location|Address) after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down. 

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

missions.title: Orison Relief: Stop Nine Tails Regrouping
missions.description:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near ~mission(Location|Address) before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.

To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.

All the best,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Orison Relief: Neutralize Nine Tails Reprisal
missions.description:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around ~mission(Location|Address) marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.

You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Orison Relief: Small Fabrication Order
missions.description:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint outlining what materials you'll need to create them. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. Either way you will need access to an Item Fabricator to make the propulsors yourself.

Once you're done bring them to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address) and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

missions.title: Orison Relief: Medium Fabrication Order
missions.description:
Hullo,

Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.

We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.

Once ready, deliver them to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). Payment sent on completion.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

missions.title: Orison Relief: Large Fabrication Order
missions.description:
Alright,

The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.

Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.

When you're done, drop the propulsors off at ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). Be a big payout with this one.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

missions.title: Orison Relief: Medical Aid Delivery
missions.description:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from ~mission(Location|Target|Address) and needs to be dropped at ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). And be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

missions.title: Orison Relief: Small Supply Haul
missions.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.

Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). Pick up’s at ~mission(Location|Target|Address). Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.

Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.

Let’s get it done,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Orison Relief: Medium Supply Haul
missions.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Crusader is still trying to make things right in Orison following the attack, so I’m hoping you’re free to keep assisting with the effort.

We been contracted to deliver relief supplies to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). Pick up’s at ~mission(Location|Target|Address). 
Not too shabby a haul either, so make sure you’re in a ship that can hold ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and bring a handheld tractor beam, or you’ll make us all look unprofessional.

I’m not kidding around with this job being important to get done right. Lotta people got hurt during the Nine Tails raid, and they’re relying on people like us to get them the help they need. So let’s do right by them, okay?

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Orison Relief: Large Supply Haul
missions.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well. 

We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address). Pick up’s at ~mission(Location|Target|Address). Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers otherwise it might be a little rough.

I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.

Let’s do right by them,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Orison Relief: Small Materials Order
missions.description:
Now then,

You might have heard about the recent attacks on the Orison platforms. Terrible stuff. The folks at Crusader are scrambling around trying to put it all back together and have contracted us to help.

To get them back on their feet what we need is construction materials. Can give you a decent pay packet for them too.

If you don't know already how to get construction materials, your best bet is to read United Resource Workers' A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection. That'll set you on the right path.

Once you've got the order ready, you'll need to drop it all off at ~mission(Destination|Target|Address).

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

missions.title: Orison Relief: Medium Materials Order

After you've got the materials, head to ~mission(Destination|Target|Address) and we'll get it sorted.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

missions.title: Extra Special Wolf

missions.title: Clipper Fight Now
missions.description: Clipper does a bunch of things good, but Wikelo think what if it did more fight? Then it still do all things, but now do one thing better. Good yes? I give you blueprint, you make my new metamaterial, bring to me, and I will trade.

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul
missions.description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from ~mission(Location|Address) to ~mission(Destination|Address) without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - … Rank - … Cargo Haul
missions.description:
We've got a shipment of contraband that needs to be hauled to a couple of different places. If you like creds, head to ~mission(Location|Address), load everything up, and bring it to these drop points:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)

You're gonna need a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes and enough room in your cargo hold for size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) containers. 

Avoid other ships if you can. Security will bust you if they figure out what you're hauling, and raiders will just take it for themselves. 

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - … Rank - … Cargo Haul
missions.description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)

And bring it all to ~mission(Destination|Address) before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) containers, and a handheld tractor beam should make loading and unloading nice and easy. 

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - … Rank - … Cargo Haul
missions.description:
We're looking for someone discreet to move a new batch of altruciatoxin to a number of buyers . Yeah, it's illegal, but only if you get caught. 

The shipment is at ~mission(Location|Address). You'll need to take it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)

Be sure your ship can carry size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) containers, and don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam. Not sure how you're planning on moving the boxes, otherwise.

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS -- … Rank, … Scale Cargo Run
missions.description:
If you're looking for creds, the Saints need someone with hauling experience to do a supply run from ~mission(Location|Address) to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

You're gonna need a ship that can hold size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes around. 

Don't open the crates but just so you know, most of this stuff is legal but not all of it. Try not to cross paths with anyone who might make that a problem for you. Get me?

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - … Rank - … Cargo Haul
missions.description:
If you've got a fast ship, can discreetly carry size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) containers, and love getting a huge payout, we need you to head to ~mission(Location|Address) immediately and take what you find there to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

The buyers are paying a premium to get their hands on fresh stormwal meat. Stay sharp. If security catches you with this, it's your ass on the line. If you're smart, you'll use a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded up quick. 

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS -- … Rank, … Scale Cargo Run
missions.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find ~mission(total) cryopods at ~mission(Location|Address) that need to go to ~mission(Destination|Address). Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

missions.title: Finishing The Job
missions.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at ~mission(Location|Address) and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at ~mission(Destination|Address) and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

missions.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
missions.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at ~mission(Location|Address). Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to ~mission(Destination|Address) and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

missions.title: Retrieval Op
missions.description:
You got a ship and a heavy-duty tractor beam? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at ~mission(Location|Address). The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to ~mission(Destination|Address) and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

missions.title: Taking Back Our Goods
missions.description:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at ~mission(Location|Address) so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at ~mission(Destination|Address).

-Twitch

missions.title: Finishing The Job
missions.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at ~mission(Location|Address).

Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in ~mission(Destination|Address). You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

missions.title: Lost But Not Gone
missions.description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at ~mission(Location|Address).

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address) and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

missions.title: Keep … Safe From Upstarts
missions.description:
You don't need all the details, but Headhunters have an interest in what happens over at ~mission(Location|Address) and I just got word they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. 

The dumb sods are trying to cripple the place by taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects). I'm not having it.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

missions.title: Protect … From Luggers
missions.description:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the <EM>~mission(Objects) at ~mission(Location|Address). We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Secure … From Rivals
missions.description:
Our friends at ~mission(Location|Address) have been compromised. A new gang in the area  are threatening them by targeting their ~mission(Objects).  

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.  
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

missions.title: Stop Gang From Destroying …
missions.description: Got word from some allies of ours over at ~mission(Location|Address) that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their ~mission(Objects). This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along. Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip. - Stows

missions.title: Defend … From Mercs
missions.description: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at ~mission(Location|Address). Seems someone has been tipped off that if the ~mission(Objects) there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.

missions.title: Guard … At All Costs
missions.description: Our partners at ~mission(Location|Address) need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the ~mission(Objects) there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order. With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage. To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong. - Stow

missions.title: Help Headhunters Prospect
missions.description:
Guess some folks just can’t dogfight. Sent a young prospect out on patrol, and am now being barraged with comms about how they’re barely hanging on. Had them update me with the details about who they’re up against and I damn near fell outta my chair laughing.    

If this kid can’t handle a People’s Alliance ship, they sure ain’t ready for flight assignments. Appreciate it if you could save their hide anyway.

If you’re free, could you head over to ~mission(Location|Address) and show ‘em how it’s done?

-Stows

missions.title: Headhunter Needs Help
missions.description:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around ~mission(Location|Address). This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships. 

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.  

-Stows

missions.title: Backup Needed Now
missions.description:
Some People’s Alliance members with a death wish decided to target one of our ships. Need someone to hustle over to ~mission(Location|Address) and show ‘em what happens when you mess with the Headhunters.

Stows out.

missions.title: Bring Down the Hammer
missions.description:
Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to ~mission(Location|Address) to give ‘em some support?

-Stows

missions.title: Rally to Help Clips Convoy
missions.description:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen. 

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to ~mission(Location|Address) immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.

missions.title: Looking for a Damn Hero
missions.description:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near ~mission(Location|Address). Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.   

-Stows

missions.title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
missions.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near ~mission(Location|Address) got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

missions.description:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

missions.title: No Fly Zone
missions.description:
Some competition has taken root at ~mission(Location|Address) and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

missions.title: Stopping the Competition
missions.description: Stopping the Competition

missions.title: Wasting Their Stockpile
missions.description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at ~mission(Location|Address). I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

missions.title: Trapping a Rat
missions.description:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at ~mission(Location|Address). If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out

missions.title: Outsmarting our Enemies
missions.description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at ~mission(Location|Address). They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

missions.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
missions.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

missions.title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
missions.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

missions.title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
missions.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at ~mission(Location|Address) and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

missions.title: Stop Rivals from Launching Heist
missions.description:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out

missions.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power
missions.description:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at  ~mission(Location|Address).

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business. 

-Stows out

missions.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
missions.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

missions.title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
missions.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at ~mission(Location|Address) and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

missions.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power
missions.description:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at  ~mission(Location|Address).

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business. 

-Stows out

missions.title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
missions.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

missions.title: Wipe Out XenoThreat Servers
missions.description:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at ~mission(Location|Address).

Would be a shame if someone, say like you, were to go there and blow it all up, huh? 

-Stows out

missions.title: Clear Citizens for Prosperity Servers
missions.description:
Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us. 

The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.

-Stows out

missions.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
missions.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people. 

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at ~mission(Location|Address).

-Stows out

missions.title: No Fly Zone
missions.description:
Some competition has taken root at ~mission(Location|Address) and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

missions.title: Shut Off Power at …
missions.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at ~mission(Location|Address) who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

missions.title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
missions.description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named ~mission(TargetName) who is operating out of ~mission(Location|Address). They've become a real concern for the Headhunters. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

missions.title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
missions.description:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out

missions.title: Eliminate Annoyance
missions.description:
Headhunters flying in and out of ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address) are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.   

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

missions.title: Protect Our Site
missions.description:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address). Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Secure Our Airspace
missions.description:
Our airspace around ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address) has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

missions.title: Help Headhunters at …
missions.description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address) are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops. 

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.  

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.  

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip.

- Stows

missions.title: Stop Attack at …
missions.description:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address), along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for a job well done. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Restore Order at …
missions.description:
Our crew at ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address) needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

missions.title: Hauling ask.
missions.description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from ~mission(Location|Address) to ~mission(Destination|Address) and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers.  A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

missions.title: Getting Our Goods Back
missions.description:
We’ve been using the old Hathor ~mission(Location1|Address) and ~mission(Location2|Address) as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address) where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) at the very least. 

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Stock Taking
missions.description:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address), then we can sort your payment. 

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Cargo Retrieval
missions.description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at ~mission(Location|Address) and deliver it to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address). 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Scrap Salvage at …
missions.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at ~mission(Location|Address). The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

missions.title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
missions.description:
CFP think they’re safe over at ~mission(Location|Address) but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.


Stows out.

missions.title: Silence the Xenothreat
missions.description:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and climb the comm towers there. Should be a control panel at the top you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.


Stows out.

missions.title: Anybody Seen …?
missions.description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name ~mission(TargetName), to do a hand-off over at ~mission(Location|Address), but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

missions.title: Track Down …
missions.description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at ~mission(Location|Address). Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to ~mission(TargetName).

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows

missions.title: Track Down …
missions.description:
A few days back I dispatched ~mission(TargetName|Last) to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and ~mission(TargetName|Last) isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Stows out.

missions.title: Track Down …
missions.description:
Sent ~mission(TargetName) out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at ~mission(Location|Address), but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

missions.title: Find …
missions.description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of ~mission(TargetName). 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

missions.title: Track Down …
missions.description:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took ~mission(TargetName) hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to break in, find ~mission(TargetName|Last), and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.
