missions.title: Claim XenoThreat …
missions.description:
Been given some primo info that could be a boon for both of us. Someone took out a XenoThreat hauler near ~mission(Location|Address). It must have some sweet, sweet salvage because a Xeno recovery team was there and working that site almost immediately. Would be a real shame if someone else showed up, knocked out the other Xeno ships, and then claimed all that salvage for their own. 

I’ve got a few colleagues interested in the action themselves, but Rough & Ready members getting caught there would only look like we’re taking sides. Would be much better if an unaffiliated force stepped in to deliver the surprise strike. 

Figure we can all win here. I’ll sell you the coordinates to the wreck, and you can clear out the XenoThreat forces and then pick it all apart. Pretty sure they’ll put up a fight for it, but just come in prepared and consider all that collateral damage as more profit off salvage. 

- Smokey

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
missions.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to ~mission(Location|Address) to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.   

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to ~mission(Location|Address) to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to ~mission(Location|Address) to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to ~mission(Location|Address) whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to ~mission(Location|Address) to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to ~mission(Location|Address) whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to ~mission(Location|Address) to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
missions.description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to ~mission(Location|Address) to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers
missions.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

LOCATION: ~mission(System)

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a ~mission(Hint_Tool).

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at ~mission(Destination|Address).

missions.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at ~mission(Destination|Address).

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Supply Order: Sadaryx Focus Lenses
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

TERMS*:
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using Sadaryx crystals and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at ~mission(Destination|Address) for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

TERMS*: 
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside. 

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
missions.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of ~mission(FuelType) at ~mission(Location|Address). I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest). As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their ~mission(Ship) and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

missions.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: …
missions.description:

missions.title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Small Resupply
missions.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply ~mission(Destination|Address) with detatrine. 

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several depots around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to resupply ~mission(Destination|Address). 

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points might be a good place to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Small Resupply
missions.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply ~mission(Destination|Address) with detatrine. 

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several depots around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Out of Detatrine – Small Resupply
missions.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a detatrine resupply run to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that depots across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

missions.title: Hunt the Polaris
missions.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

This is a call to arms for all available Civilian Defense Force volunteers. An RSI Polaris corvette on its way to Invictus Launch Week festivities has been hijacked by the terrorist organization the Frontier Fighters. Initial intelligence reports indicate they’re attempting to escape into the Pyro system.

The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support immediately to neutralize this threat and prevent the Frontier Fighters from escaping with the stolen capital ship.  Additionally, as a further incentive, those who assist us in this endeavor will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip along with a small token of our appreciation.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

missions.title: Happy Invictus
missions.description:
Hello Citizens and Civilians,

The United Empire of Earth is proud to acknowledge the start of this year's Invictus ceremony. Originally started in 2542, the United Planets of Earth dispatched Naval ships to each of the settled planets to pick up the latest group of volunteers entering military service.

Now, over four hundred years later, Invictus continues this proud tradition of celebrating those among us who are standing up for others and protecting the Empire as well as showcasing the latest additions to the Naval fleet.

This year's festivities can be found on ArcCorp in Stanton and feature a great hall with some of the newest ships on display as well as the new Idris Experience Tour where you can tour an active-duty Idris, accessible at the top of the IO-North tower.

Accept this contract if you would like guidance to the festivities. As a special thank you, in partnership with the Mercenary Guild, attendees will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) scrip.

Thank you and enjoy your Invictus.

missions.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #1
missions.description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #2
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part one of this three-part course.

For your next patrol scenario, things are going to become even more intense.

Be prepared to encounter some hostiles and dogfight them in a realistic combat scenario just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol.

The hostile ships are all specially equipped rigs made specifically for training purposes and will be piloted by graduates of the flight school to provide an engaging and educational experience.

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #2 – Neutralizing a Hostile Threat

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

Make sure you pick a ship ready for combat and I’ll see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #3
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Treatment Cargo Haul - Small Scale

Hi,

We’ve joined the effort to help those affected by the Molina mold outbreak. There’s a small scale haul of urgently needed treatment waiting to be picked up from ~mission(Location|Address) and delivered to ~mission(Destination|Address). Any chance you’re available?  
   
All you’ll need is a ship that can fit ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to make moving the stuff easier on you. 
 

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Can you head to ~mission(Location|Address) to pick up a small scale haul of cryopods and bring them to ~mission(Destination|Address) so they can get the help they need?   

If you haven’t dealt with a cryopod before, you’ll need a ship with a hold that can fit a container up to ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) in size. A handheld tractor beam will also be needed to move them around.  

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Small Supply of Research Resource
missions.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

To help us expand our access to it, we will be offering an excellent rate for those who help find and deliver it to our scientists at ~mission(Destination|Address).

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Collect Manufacturing Resource - Small Scale
missions.description:
POSTING: Resource Gathering 
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
As a member of Alliance Aid, Shubin Interstellar is dedicated to assisting in the production of as many high quality ventilation filters as possible. These filters are key to stopping the spread of Molina Mold and keeping more people from being stricken with the People’s Ailment. 

We’ve just received word from our facility at ~mission(Destination|Address) that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap. 
 
If you’re available, simply acquire it as you see best and bring it to our facility, and we’ll compensate you well.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Escort Needed
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from ~mission(Location|Address) for the ongoing relief effort. 

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Owing with the increased risk level and the value of the ship, it might behoove you to bring some combat support of your own along.

If you’re interested, head to the rendezvous and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Trouble

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Distress
missions.description:

Once you're ready, head to ~mission(Location|Address) and face these criminals head on.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Ship Under Attack
missions.description:

One of the critical relief convoys was just attacked by a powerful outlaw fleet. We need you to put together a fleet of your own and deploy to ~mission(Location|Address) as soon as possible. With any luck, you may be able to right this wrong before it's too late.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Double Interstellar Med. Haul (Medical / Filters)
missions.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to ~mission(Destination|Address). 
 
To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to ~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) in size. 

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Molina Mold Samples
missions.description:
Let me start by saying that your continuing work helping the Alliance Aid efforts so far have made a considerable difference not only to us at Rayari, but to the rest of the organizations coordinating with the Collections Division. It's why I wanted to reach out to you directly. 

While we have been making great strides in combating this ongoing health crisis, there is concern amongst our researchers that Molina Mold has the potential to mutate into a new fungal strain. 
In order in ensure that our ongoing investigation into the mold is as accurate as possible, we would like you to head to the source of the growth in Levski and  harvest new samples of the Molina Mold  there directly. 

Once you have the samples collected, you will then need to deliver them to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Thank you for your assistance at this vital juncture. 

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Urgent Rescue Mission
missions.description:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack. 

We need you to hurry to ~mission(Location|Address), neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address). 

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
